name: Combustion Engineering
summary: The chemistry and physics of flames, burners and fuels, with emphasis on engines, furnaces and pollutant control.

topics.name: Thermochemistry and equilibrium composition of combustion products
Chemical kinetics: reaction rates, mechanisms and ignition delay
Chemically reacting system models (well-stirred and plug-flow reactors)
Laminar premixed flames: flame speed, flammability limits, quenching
Droplet evaporation, sprays and liquid-fuel combustion
Pollutant formation and control: NOx, CO, soot, unburned hydrocarbons
Alternative fuels: hydrogen, ammonia and biofuels
